instructions:
Genomic data retrieval and reference evidence. Intervals are 0-based half-open with an
explicit assembly; nothing is lifted over. VariantSpec.pos is VCF POS (1-based).
Results are envelopes with status ok/partial/error, provenance and explicit truncation.
Read genomics://capabilities to see which operations this build implements.
